description: Source code implementing Zephyr-specific functions for the VL53L1X sensor, including I2C read/write operations, delays, and polling mechanisms.

methods.name: VL53L1_WriteMulti
methods.description: Writes multiple bytes to a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: VL53L1_ReadMulti
methods.description: Reads multiple bytes from a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: VL53L1_WrByte
methods.description: Writes a single byte to a register.

methods.name: VL53L1_WrWord
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit word to a register.

methods.name: VL53L1_WrDWord
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit double word to a register.

methods.name: VL53L1_RdByte
methods.description: Reads a byte from a register.

methods.name: VL53L1_RdWord
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit word from a register.

methods.name: VL53L1_RdDWord
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit double word from a register.

methods.name: VL53L1_WaitUs
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of microseconds.

methods.name: VL53L1_WaitMs
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: VL53L1_GetTickCount
methods.description: Retrieves the current tick count in milliseconds.

methods.name: VL53L1_WaitValueMaskEx
methods.description: Polls a register until a specific value and mask are matched or timeout occurs.
